name: refiner
description: The AI side of the focus loop as a lane in the model: a hand-over request becomes a refinement, structure or ground pass run by an agent through the Agentic-Nets MCP server, with its run recorded.
author: AgenticNetOS

stores.description: Hand-over requests: a pass the person asked the AI to run; consumed by the lane when it runs
What each run did: the agent's report (summary, changes, questions, passId)
Where the coder works: the root folder of the model's sources on the executor, the coder (claude or codex) and its model; append-only, the newest record wins

actions.name: request
actions.description: Hand the focus work over to the AI: a refinement pass (apply answers and briefs, prepare the next questions), a structure pass (settle the AI's cards from the sources) or a ground pass (check the levels against the sources), optionally limited to a focus scope and a subject. One record per requestId; the lane t-refiner-pass consumes it. Kinds that read the sources (structure, ground, look, explain, check, draft, diff) are delegated to the headless-coder tool net.

modelId.description: The model the pass runs on; the lane passes it to every MCP call

scope.description: A focus scope (domain:<d>, tag:<t>, net:<session::net>); empty for the whole model

subject.description: One subject to concentrate on first

note.description: What the person wants from this pass, in their words

runner.description: agent: the lane t-refiner-pass (no sources needed); coder: the headless-coder tool net (reads the sources)

status.description: requested: waiting for t-refiner-pass; delegated: handed to the headless coder

card.description: The Focus card the request came from (kind, title, detail, question)

actions.name: configure
actions.description: Set where and with what the coder works: the root folder of the model's sources on the executor (a path, ~ allowed), the coder (claude or codex) and an optional model. Append-only; the newest record wins.
